title: Glowworm cave ceiling over an underground stream
source: Generated with Midjourney for Taste (job 3c0ae3bd, variant 1 of 4)
prompt: a glowworm cave ceiling with hanging threads and an underground stream (Waitomo-style long exposure); see /home/claude/taste/mj/glowworm/
note: The photo's own glowworms and threads were found with a median top-hat filter (blue-green, small, bright) and inpainted (OpenCV Telea); under the dense glow, where no rock survived, the plate is smoothed and the shader adds limestone relief. Its lighting was flattened into a neutral limestone albedo and the warm light in the far tunnel removed (grotto-albedo.webp, 1456x816). grotto-maps.png (728x408) holds, in R, the density of the photo's glow points (local maxima, Gaussian sigma 7 px), which is where the procedural larvae are placed; in G, a hand-drawn water mask; in B, the photo's diffuse blue-green haze; in A, a soft ceiling mask. grotto-poster.webp is a render of the component at rest, used as the no-JS background.
